preconditions.description: The number of records in the input must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(op, str) for op in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation in the input must be a string.
Each operation must start with 'insert', 'getMin', or 'removeMin'.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of operations followed by the corrected sequence of operations.
The number of operations in the output must match the specified minimum number m.

postconditions.expression: all(op in operations for op in corrected_operations)
postconditions.description: The corrected operations must include all original operations in the same order.
